messages.PewterGymBrockPreBattleText: I'm BROCK! I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER!I believe in rock hard defense and determination!That's why my POKEMON are all the rock-type!Do you still want to challenge me? Fine then! Show me your best!
messages.PewterGymBrockPostBattleAdviceText: There are all kinds of trainers in the world!Some raise POKEMON for fights. Some see them as pets.I'm in training to become a POKEMON breeder.If you take your POKEMON training seriously, go visit the GYM in CERULEAN and test your abilities!
messages.TM34ExplanationText: A TM contains a technique that can be taught to POKEMON!A TM is good only once! So when you use one to teach a new technique, pick the POKEMON carefully!TM34 contains BIDE!Your POKEMON will absorb damage in battle then pay it back double!
messages.PewterGymTM34NoRoomText: You don't have room for this!
messages.PewterGymBrockReceivedBoulderBadgeText: I took you for granted.As proof of your victory, here's the BOULDERBADGE!You received the BOULDERBADGE!
messages.PewterGymBrockBoulderBadgeInfoText: That's an official POKEMON LEAGUE BADGE!Its bearer's POKEMON become more powerful!The technique FLASH can now be used anytime!
messages.PewterGymCooltrainerMBattleText: Stop right there, kid!You're still light years from facing BROCK!
messages.PewterGymCooltrainerMEndBattleText: Darn!Light years isn't time! It measures distance!
messages.PewterGymCooltrainerMAfterBattleText: You're pretty hot, but not as hot as BROCK!
messages.PewterGymGuidePreAdviceText: Hiya! I can tell you have what it takes to become a POKEMON champ!I'm no trainer, but I can tell you how to win!Let me take you to the top!
messages.PewterGymGuideAdviceText: The 1st POKEMON out in a match is at the top of the POKEMON LIST!By changing the order of POKEMON, matches could be made easier!
messages.PewterGymGuideFreeServiceText: It's a free service! Let's get happening!
messages.PewterGymGuidePostBattleText: Just as I thought! You're POKEMON champ material!
messages.PewterGymGuyText: All right! Let's get happening!It will be tough for your PIKACHU at this GYM!Electric attacks are harmless to BROCK's ground- type POKEMON.
